name: Job scheduling game
summary: Selfish jobs choose machines to minimize the total processing load on their chosen machine.
rules_text: There are M machines and N players, each player is a job. Each job i has a private processing time p_i^j for each machine j. Simultaneously, each player chooses one machine. The load L_j on machine j is the sum of p_i^j over all jobs that chose j. Each player's cost is L_j for the machine they chose; each player wants to minimize their own cost. The global makespan is max_j L_j, but payoffs are individual loads. Play is one simultaneous choice round.
